stories.title: the iced cardamom latte
stories.dek: WatchHouse × sam'spresso. Cardamom-bun flavours, poured over ice. This weekend only.

body.text: We asked WatchHouse to bottle the thing everyone queues for: the cardamom bun. The answer is a spiced oat latte, shaken cold, with a cinnamon-sugar rim.
It's on at Bermondsey and Soho until Sunday close, or until they run out of the syrup, which last time took about four hours.

body.note: Order it with an extra shot if you like it less sweet.

stories.title: the post-reformer iced edit
stories.dek: Five cold, clean, oat-friendly cups for after class.

body.text: Class done, cheeks pink, and you want something cold that doesn't taste like a milkshake. These are the ones we keep coming back to.

body.note: Creamy, barely sweet, and right by South Ken station.
The cult one. Samia's pick for a reason.
Mellow and big. Good for a slow walk through Bloomsbury.
Grassy, creamy, refreshing. The only matcha on the list.
No milk, all chocolate. For the purists.

stories.title: the tiny counter at the top
stories.dek: How a standing-room spot by Bank became London's best-rated café.

body.text: There are no tables at Rosslyn. There's a counter, a window and a queue of people in good coats who know exactly what they want.
What they want is milk. The cortado is dense and chocolatey; the flat white is the smoothest in the Square Mile. Both sit at the top of our leaderboard.

body.note: Start here. Two sips in, you'll get it.

stories.title: where to work when it's grey out
stories.dek: Bright rooms, good Wi-Fi, no side-eye for staying a while.

body.text: Some days the laptop has to leave the flat. These are the places that make that feel like a treat.

body.note: Huge windows, long benches and a batch brew that keeps coming.
Roastery energy. Get the V60 and stay for the afternoon.
That skylight. Go before 10 for a table.

stories.title: new on the map
stories.dek: Marylebone, Victoria and South Ken are in. Three new cafés to rate.

body.text: We've stretched the map west and south. Say hello to three new spots, and tell us what we should add next.
